A '''Jedi Temple''' was located on the [[Outer Rim Territories]] [[planet]] [[Dantooine]], operated by the [[Jedi Order]].<ref name="Gadgets and Gears" /> Records about Jedi on the planet went back several centuries, but they had apparently left by the time of the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="BMF">{{BuildFalconCite|37|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref>
